# Joel Chapter 3 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 334r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/JOL_003_page_001.jpg

---

**3:1** "For behold [ki hinneh], in-those days [ba-yammim ha-hemmah] and-in-that time [u-va-et ha-hi], when I-restore [ashuv] the-fortunes [shevut] of-Yehudah [Judah] and-Yerushalayim, **3:2** I-will-gather [veqibbatsti] all the-nations [kol-ha-goyim] and-bring-them-down [vehoradtim] to the-valley [emeq] of-Yehoshafat [Jehoshaphat], and-I-will-enter-into-judgment [venishpateti] with-them there [sham] on-account-of my-people [ammi] and-my-inheritance [venachalati] Yisra'el, whom they-scattered [pizzeru] among-the-nations, and-my-land [artsi] they-divided [chillequ]."

**3:3** "And-over my-people they-cast [yaddu] lots [goral], and-they-gave [vayyittenu] the-boy [ha-yeled] for-a-harlot [ba-zonah], and-the-girl [veha-yaldah] they-sold [makheru] for-wine [be-yayin] and-drank [vayyishtu]."

**3:4** "And-also [vegam] what [are] you to-me, Tsor [Tyre] and-Tsidon [Sidon] and-all the-regions [gelilot] of-Pelashet [Philistia]? Are-you repaying [meshallmim] me [a] recompense [gemul]? And-if you-are-repaying me, swiftly [qal] [and] speedily [meherah] I-will-return [ashiv] your-recompense on-your-head [roshkhem]."

**3:5** "Because [asher] my-silver [kaspi] and-my-gold [u-zehavi] you-took [leqachtem], and-my-best [meitavai] treasures [machmadai] you-brought [have'etem] into-your-temples [hekhloteikhem]."

**3:6** "And-the-sons of-Yehudah and-the-sons of-Yerushalayim you-sold [mekhartem] to-the-sons of-the-Greeks [ha-Yevanim], in-order-to remove-them-far [leharchiqam] from-upon their-border [gevulam]."

**3:7** "Behold, I [am] stirring-them-up [me'iram] from the-place [ha-maqom] where you-sold [mekhartem] them there, and-I-will-return [vahashivoti] your-recompense on-your-head."

**3:8** "And-I-will-sell [umakharti] your-sons and-your-daughters into-the-hand [be-yad] of-the-sons of-Yehudah, and-they-will-sell-them to-the-Sabeans [Sheva'im], to a-nation [goy] far-off [rachoq]; for YHWH has-spoken [dibber]."

**3:9** "Proclaim [qir'u] this among the-nations: Consecrate [qaddishu] a-war [milchamah]; rouse [ha'iru] the-warriors [ha-gibborim]; let-them-draw-near [yiggashu] and-come-up [ya'alu], all the-men of-war [anshei ha-milchamah]."

**3:10** "Beat [kottu] your-plowshares [itteikhem] into-swords [la-charavot], and-your-pruning-hooks [u-mazmeroteikhem] into-spears [li-remachim]; let-the-weak [ha-challash] say, 'I [am] a-warrior [gibbor].'"

**3:11** "Hasten [ushu] and-come [uvo'u], all the-nations [goyim] from-round-about [mi-saviv], and-gather-yourselves [venikbatsu] there." Bring-down [hanechat], YHWH, your-warriors [gibborekha].

**3:12** "Let-the-nations [goyim] be-roused [ye'oru] and-come-up [veya'alu] to the-valley of-Yehoshafat; for there I-will-sit [eshev] to-judge [lishpot] all the-nations from-round-about."

**3:13** "Send [shilchu] [the] sickle [maggal], for the-harvest [qatsir] is-ripe [bashot]; come [bo'u], go-down [redu], for the-winepress [gat] is-full [male'ah]; the-vats [ha-yeqavim] overflow [heshiqu]; for great [rabbah] [is] their-evil [ra'atam]."

**3:14** "Multitudes [hamonim], multitudes [hamonim] in-the-valley of-the-decision [emeq ha-charuts]; for near [qarov] [is] the-day of-YHWH in-the-valley of-the-decision."

**3:15** "The-sun and-the-moon are-darkened [qadru], and-the-stars gather-in their-brightness."

**3:16** "And-YHWH from-Tsiyon roars [yish'ag], and-from-Yerushalayim gives [yitten] his-voice; and-the-heavens and-the-earth tremble [ra'ashu]; but-YHWH [is] a-shelter [machaseh] for-his-people and-a-stronghold [u-ma'oz] for-the-sons of-Yisra'el."

**3:17** "And-you-will-know [vidaatem] that I [am] YHWH your-God, dwelling [shokhen] in-Tsiyon, my-holy mountain; and-Yerushalayim shall-be holy [qodesh], and-strangers [zarim] shall-not pass [ya'avru] through-her again [od]."

**3:18** "And-it-will-be [vehayah] in-that day [ba-yom ha-hu], the-mountains [ha-harim] will-drip [yittefu] sweet-wine [asis], and-the-hills [ha-geva'ot] will-flow [telakhnah] [with] milk [chalav], and-all the-channels [afiqei] of-Yehudah will-flow [yelkhu] [with] water [mayim]; and-a-spring [ma'yan] from-the-house [mi-beit] of-YHWH will-go-out [yetse] and-water [vehishqah] the-valley [nachal] of-Shittim [the Acacias]."

**3:19** "Mitsrayim [Egypt] a-desolation [li-shemamah] shall-be, and-Edom a-wilderness [midbar] of-desolation shall-be, because-of the-violence [chamas] [against] the-sons of-Yehudah, in-whose-land they-shed [shafkhu] innocent [naqi] blood [dam]."

**3:20** "But-Yehudah shall-dwell [teshev] forever [le-olam], and-Yerushalayim for-generation [le-dor] and-generation."

**3:21** "And-I-will-avenge [veniqqeiti] their-blood [damam] [which] I-have-not-avenged [lo niqqeiti]; and-YHWH dwells [shokhen] in-Tsiyon."

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.2 — "Valley of Jehoshaphat":** *Yehoshafat* means "YHWH judges." The valley may be symbolic rather than geographic, though later tradition identified it with the Kidron Valley east of Jerusalem.

**v.10 — "Beat your plowshares into swords":** This deliberately reverses Isaiah 2:4/Micah 4:3 ("they shall beat their swords into plowshares"). Joel summons the nations to arm themselves — not for their victory, but for YHWH's judgment.

**v.14 — "Multitudes, multitudes":** *Hamonim, hamonim* — the repetition creates an overwhelming sense of masses gathered for judgment. *Charuts* means "decision/decree" — the valley where the verdict falls.

**v.18 — The eschatological spring:** A spring flowing from the Temple to water the Valley of Shittim (Acacias) parallels Ezekiel 47:1-12 and Zechariah 14:8. The image of water from the sanctuary transforming arid land is a major prophetic motif.

*— EMET*
